gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-slabo-13px: Friendly, spaced-out letters up top. Slabo 13px follows with a serif that feels bookish and dignified, so Nasalization's soft hum and the body's tall, open shapes sit comfortably together.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-suwannaphum: Nasalization draws every stroke with one steady gauge. Suwannaphum, a classic serif with a tall, squared-off build, gives that smooth heading an editorial partner that feels firmer underneath.
gen-dafont-nasalization-inter: Inter reads like a smooth, hollow tube, with big counters and a sensible, professional manner. Nasalization floats above it with friendly, widely spaced letters, so the sans-serif body feels like a steady floor beneath a playful sign.
gen-dafont-nasalization-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab packs its slab-serif lines with a dominant middle zone and open throats on a, c, e and s. Nasalization sketches over it like pencil, light and friendly.
gen-dafont-neon-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, with generous gaps where its curves meet the stems. Neon's glowing, tall lowercase sits above it.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-epunda-slab: Glowing and vibrant, Neon runs every curve as thick as its stems, tall like stamped metal type. Epunda Slab, a serif, answers with a visibly gaping c and a dignified, rounded lowercase.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One brings a literary, dignified feel, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders. And Neon's glowing, bowl-flat letters give the classic serif a vivid, buzzing sign to stand beneath.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-kadwa: Kadwa opens its curves wide and carries a larger-than-usual x-height, which gives the serif an editorial, classic look. Kadwa stays inviting over a long passage, while Neon's one-line-weight glow above it keeps things vibrant.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noticia-text: Glowing lines, flat as wire. Noticia Text, a classic serif with big entrances into each curve and lowercase that fills most of the letter height, adds a literary, dignified weight below Neon's bright, unvarying strokes.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-pridi: Bright, outlined and uniform, Neon does glow and vibrance better than anything. But Pridi, a text serif with proud, nearly capital-sized small letters, handles the refined, classic reading below.
